change_control: Issue a new version and recode every passage; never silently edit this frozen codebook.

codes.definition: The policy commits to making an official resource available to the public without an account or access fee.
codes.exclusion_rule: Exclude staff-only access, undefined future access, and access that requires an account or fee.
codes.inclusion_rule: Apply when the text expressly provides public access and states either no fee or no account barrier.
codes.label: Public access commitment

codes.definition: The policy names at least two implementation stages and gives a date or deadline for each stage.
codes.exclusion_rule: Exclude a single deadline, an undated aspiration, or an ordering of steps without dates.
codes.inclusion_rule: Apply when a pilot or interim stage and a complete stage each have an explicit date.
codes.label: Phased implementation schedule

codes.definition: A reviewer outside the implementing department examines decisions and reports findings.
codes.exclusion_rule: Exclude internal quality checks and external advice that includes no review of decisions.
codes.inclusion_rule: Apply when the text identifies an external reviewer, a review object, and a reporting duty.
codes.label: Independent review mechanism
